audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer uses fabricated/swapped names throughout: 'E Refract' (real: W Rebuttal, the reflect barrier, 38/35/33/29/26s CD), 'W Solar Snare' (Solar Snare is her E, the root), 'R Overwhelm' (R is Golden Eclipse; Overwhelm is the passive stack from Searing Brilliance). winCon and dosFull[1] reference a 'silence' Mel does not have. Rebuttal reflecting Qiyana's R is grounded (R carries the projectile flag; W reflects projectiles).
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names; no silence anywhere in Mel's kit.
audit.corrected: All names corrected across spikes, early/mid/late, whys, wants; silence references replaced with the Solar Snare root; R-shockwave-reflect stated explicitly.

audit.why: Rebuttal 38s rank 1 (26s max), Solar Snare 11s rank 1.

edits.before: Mel is an immobile artillery-style mage whose only defensive tools are E Refract and W Solar Snare, so once you have your dashes she can't kite you. Do not throw Q Edge of Ixtal into a raised Refract or it reflects back at you; instead E Audacity in first, dodge her W root, then Q point-blank. Every trade where Refract is down is a heavy chunk in your favour.
edits.after: Mel is an immobile artillery-style mage whose only defensive tools are W Rebuttal and E Solar Snare, so once you have your dashes she can't kite you. Do not throw Q Edge of Ixtal into a raised Rebuttal — it blocks the damage and reflects projectiles; instead E Audacity in first, dodge her E root, then Q point-blank. Every trade where Rebuttal is down is a heavy chunk in your favour.

edits.before: R Supreme Display of Talent lets you delete her the instant she wastes E Refract or W Solar Snare. Save your engage until her Refract is on cooldown, since committing into an active shield reflects your projectile and stalls the kill. With her frame this squishy, a clean E-Q-R once Refract is spent is lethal even through her passive Overwhelm stacks.
edits.after: R Supreme Display of Talent lets you delete her the instant she wastes W Rebuttal or E Solar Snare. Save your engage until Rebuttal is on cooldown, since your R shockwave is a projectile and a live Rebuttal sends it back. With her frame this squishy, a clean E-Q-R once Rebuttal is spent is lethal even through her passive Overwhelm stacks.

edits.before: Your first item keeps you ahead in lane: you one-combo her whenever Refract and her W are down. Bait the shield with a feint or a minion-blocked Q, then all-in. Shove and roam with element movement speed, because Mel is slow to rotate and can't punish your absence.
edits.after: Your first item keeps you ahead in lane: you one-combo her whenever Rebuttal and her E are down. Bait the shield with a feint or a minion-blocked Q, then all-in. Shove and roam with element movement speed, because Mel is slow to rotate and can't punish your absence.

edits.before: Two items tip to Mel: her R Overwhelm detonates stacked damage for a massive teamfight nuke, and E Refract can bounce your dive's damage and CC straight back. If you flank a shielded Mel you get reflected and blown up. Force Refract early, or let a teammate soak it before you commit your combo.
edits.after: Two items tip to Mel: R Golden Eclipse detonates her stacked Overwhelm for a massive teamfight nuke, and W Rebuttal can bounce your dive's damage straight back. If you flank a shielded Mel you get reflected and blown up. Force Rebuttal early, or let a teammate soak it before you commit your combo.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are yours because Mel is an immobile mage with only E Refract and W Solar Snare for safety, and your dashes ignore both if you time them. Never Q into a raised Refract; dash in first, sidestep the W root, and punish her squishy frame on every shield cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 1-5 are yours because Mel is an immobile mage with only W Rebuttal and E Solar Snare for safety, and your dashes ignore both if you time them. Never Q into a raised Rebuttal; dash in first, sidestep the E root, and punish her squishy frame on every shield cooldown.

edits.before: Level 6 stays in your favour: R Supreme Display of Talent one-shots her whenever Refract is down, so bait the shield then commit E-Q-R. Keep shoving and roaming, since she can't rotate or answer your movement speed.
edits.after: Level 6 stays in your favour: R Supreme Display of Talent one-shots her whenever Rebuttal is down, so bait the shield then commit E-Q-R. Keep shoving and roaming, since she can't rotate or answer your movement speed.
